name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Eligible farmer families can receive ₹6,000 per year through direct benefit transfer.
howToApply: Apply through the official PM-KISAN portal or through the appropriate government agriculture authorities.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Provides eligible households support for obtaining an LPG connection.
howToApply: Apply through an authorized LPG distributor or the official PMUY process.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
benefit: Financial assistance is provided to eligible meritorious students pursuing higher education.
howToApply: Applications are generally submitted through the National Scholarship Portal when the application window is open.
